sources.title: BitVLA: 1-bit Vision-Language-Action Models for Robotics Manipulation
sources.snippet: Abstract Deploying powerful Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models on edge devices is limited by their massive size. In this paper, we take a deployment-oriented view of VLA training: we target efficiency through model design and optimization, rather than relying solely on post-hoc compression.
